title: Surfline Rideable Hours by Swell Direction
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surf:forecast swell_direction=* rideable_hours=*
| stats avg(rideable_hours) as avg_rideable_hours, count as events by swell_direction
| sort - avg_rideable_hours
description: Shows average rideable hours by swell direction for surf-forecast windows.
value: Average rideable hours by swell direction helps compare surf-forecast windows across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `rideable_hours` on `surf:forecast` events and normalize `swell_direction` so Splunk can summarize performance by swell direction.
visualization: Bar chart of average rideable hours by swell direction.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates the average rideable hours for each swell direction so you can see what works best for surf-forecast windows.
